canonical_mrr.definition: MRR@5 over the frozen candidate pool
canonical_mrr.gold_match: evidence (chunk id) match against p0 evidence mapping (exact+fuzzy)
canonical_mrr.difference_explanation: Phase 3A official MRR (0.6167) was computed over the Phase 3A P0 retrieval instantiation (top-5). Phase 4C frozen pool (same config, new phase4_frozen_index retrieval) yields MRR@5=0.6201. The 0.0034 gap comes from two independent retrieval instantiations, not from a metric bug. Historical Phase 3A numbers are not modified.

recall_at_k.definition: per-question hit if any gold-mapped chunk id appears in top-K retrieved candidates

gold_evidence_recall.definition: per-question hit if any gold-mapped chunk id appears anywhere in the retrieved candidate list

gold_page_recall.definition: per-question hit if any top-5 (file, page) overlaps gold pages

evidence_precision_at_5.definition: fraction of top-5 retrieved chunk ids that are gold-mapped, averaged over questions

citation_metrics.definition: per-question citation set matched to gold (file, page)

notes: fuzzy evidence mapping entries count as mapped and contribute to recall metrics
unmapped citations do not count as failures; they simply provide no mapped id
MRR canonical definition applies to Phase 4D and later sub-phases
